__metadata__.name: SORC — Spatial Omics Resource in Cancer
__metadata__.description: Cell-type-annotated, spatially resolved transcriptomic and matched single-cell RNA-seq metadata across 82 datasets / 269 tissue slices spanning 17 cancer types, with pointers to spatially variable gene (SVG) calls, cell-type deconvolution proportions, immune-tumor co-occurrence, GSVA functional enrichment, and ligand-receptor cell-cell communication result files.
